name: Lovesong
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from 89 North (Patchogue) - music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Not the same as 'LOVESONG - The Cure Tribute' (Rusty Wilmot, booked by Switch Entertainment, tours the South/Midwest). The band's own tour flyer on its site lists Long Island dates at 89 North, Stage 317 (Farmingdale), Live On The Porch, Mulcahy's, Napper Tandy's Smithtown and The Silk Factory. Logo is white on a transparent background (needs a dark backdrop). Booking email is a Gmail address the band publishes on its own contact page for bookings. No Spotify or Bandcamp (covers act).
description: Long Island tribute band that plays 1980s new wave hits by Duran Duran, INXS, The Cure, Tears for Fears, Depeche Mode, Erasure and New Order, with a big light and video show.

evidence.note: Band site: '80s new wave tribute (Duran Duran, INXS, The Cure, Tears for Fears, Depeche Mode, Erasure, New Order) with lights and visuals; links to Facebook, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.
Contact page gives a Gmail address with a 'Lovesong Booking Info' subject line for bookings, plus a stage plot.
Live On The Porch (Smithtown) lists 'Lovesong - An '80s New Wave Experience' on Dec 4, 2026, naming the same bands.
The Boat Yard at Tobay Beach (Massapequa) lists several 2026 Lovesong shows; webtunes notes a show filmed at 89 North in Patchogue on 12/12/2025.
